description: HP-38 is the Registration and Licensing Authority (RLA) based in Nurpur, serving the Nurpur sub-division of Kangra district. The office is responsible for vehicle registrations, driving license issuance, and road tax collection within its jurisdiction. It plays a significant role in managing transport regulations in the northern region of Himachal Pradesh.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Nurpur, District Kangra, Himachal Pradesh
